DATA ANALYST JOB SUMMARY An established insurance brokerage is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to turn operational, financial and health plan data into clear insights for management and clients. The role owns the data behind the company's management and balanced scorecards, produces health plan analytics for group clients, and builds the dashboards and reports that support decision-making across the business. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Management & Balanced Scorecards - Build and maintain the company's management scorecards and balanced scorecard, covering financial, client, internal process, and people and learning perspectives. - Work with department heads to define KPIs, targets, data sources and measurement rules so results are consistent and trusted. - Collect, validate and report scorecard results on a monthly and quarterly basis, highlighting performance against target and emerging risks. - Prepare scorecard packs and commentary for the Executive Team and the Board. Health Plan Analytics - Analyse group health plan data, including claims experience, loss ratios, premiums and utilisation by benefit, provider, diagnosis and member group. - Identify cost drivers, trends, high-cost claimants and areas for plan design or cost-containment recommendations. - Produce client-facing experience reports and analysis to support renewals, plan reviews and self-funded plan reporting. - Support pricing, benchmarking and renewal negotiations with accurate, well-presented data. Reporting, Dashboards & Data Visualisation - Build and maintain dashboards and recurring management reports (e.g. Power BI, Excel). - Design clear, accurate charts and visualisations that communicate trends and performance at a glance to non-technical audiences. - Prepare data, charts and analysis for client reports, proposals, tenders and board papers. Data Quality & Process - Extract, clean and validate data from multiple internal systems, insurers and external sources. - Reconcile data across systems and flag gaps, duplicates and data-quality issues for resolution. - Document data sources, definitions and report logic so reporting is consistent and repeatable. - Support automation of manual reporting processes. - Maintain strict confidentiality of personal and medical data in line with data protection requirements. EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS Minimum Requirements: - Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Economics, Business or a related field. Desirable: - Certification in Data Analytics or Business Intelligence (e.g. Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst). MINIMUM EXPERIENCE - 2–3 years' experience in a data analysis, reporting or business intelligence role. - Experience with health insurance, employee benefits, claims or TPA data is a strong asset. - Experience developing KPI frameworks or balanced scorecards is an asset. REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES - Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, Power Query). - Working knowledge of SQL and Power BI or a similar BI tool. - Working knowledge of data visualisation principles: choosing the right chart for the data, designing clear dashboards, and presenting insights visually for different audiences. - Understanding of KPI design and performance measurement, including the Balanced Scorecard framework. - Familiarity with health claims data and concepts such as loss ratios, utilisation and claims trends - Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to data quality. - Ability to explain complex data clearly in writing and in presentations. - Ability to manage multiple reporting deadlines. - Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot to support analysis (e.g. writing SQL, cleaning data, drafting report commentary) is an asset, together with sound judgment on protecting confidential data.
